fields.title: Main-side library writers update the live record, never a copy
fields.description: `delete-doc`, the three queue handlers and `apply-metadata-updates` update records in place instead of building replacement arrays. The URL import, the extension import and the lazy conversion write through a new `writeConversionResult` in `main/library-write.js`, which never resurrects a deleted record and removes the orphaned converted EPUB.
